create_whilei_loop_state: create a WhileiLoopState dataclass with counter, state, and loop_statistics fields for JAX pytree differentiation
run_whilei_loop: run a backward-mode differentiable while loop that applies compute_state on incrementing counters until cond_fun returns false
define_whilei_loop_jvp: define a custom JVP rule for whilei_loop that computes tangents only on the final iteration step
build_differentiable_loop: build a differentiable JAX while loop where gradients of the final state propagate w.r.t. pytree args without storing intermediate states
test_whilei_loop_cond: test a whilei_loop with a cond_fun that checks state and additional pytree args to control loop continuation
